description: Account payment create: missing usd agrees and the POST body once confirmed. Rejections carry confirm because the gate runs before the rules. Invalid-amount texts diverge per language and stay in each one's validate hook. A successful response must be a decodable JSON object.

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This makes an account payment. Set confirm=true to proceed.

cases.name: rejects an amount that is not a positive dollar figure
cases.expect_error: usd must be a positive dollar amount with up to two decimals

cases.name: rejects an amount carrying more than two decimals
cases.expect_error: usd must be a positive dollar amount with up to two decimals

cases.name: rejects a non-positive payment method id
cases.expect_error: payment_method_id must be a positive integer
